dct_title_s: Satellite detected waters extents, as of 16 October 2019 over MayoDanay and Logone-et-Chari Department, Far-North Region
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20191017CMR** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface water in Mayo-Danay and Logone-et-Chari Department, Far-North Region of Cameroon as observed from Sentinel-2 imagery acquired on 16 October 2019. Within the analysed extent of about 2,500 km2, a total about 211 km2 of land appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.
